title: Can Prompting LLMs Unlock Hate Speech Detection across Languages? A Zero-shot and Few-shot Study

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance of instruction-tuned Large Language Models (LLMs) on hate speech detection across eight non-English languages (Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Italian, Turkish, Hindi, and Arabic) to assess linguistic disparities and capabilities compared to fine-tuned multilingual encoder models.

Testing the models' ability to accurately classify explicit hate speech targeting protected groups (based on race, religion, ethnicity, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, or disability) using real-world datasets and the HateCheck functional benchmark.
